verdict.rationale: Kong publishes a Konnect AI Gateway v1 API reference with operations such as list-ai-gateways, so the management plane can be driven programmatically. The kongctl CLI adds declarative and imperative control, and the gateway exposes a documented provider-agnostic API for model traffic. The OpenAPI probe 404s only reflect guessed standard paths, not the absence of a spec, since a published API reference exists. Missing for 10: evidence of breadth beyond a single listed endpoint, documented API authentication and rate limits, an OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
